label: SEFIR system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a SEFIR locus represented by a bSEFIR profile that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: SEFIR branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual genes, bSEFIR proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one SEFIR locus, unresolved SEFIR trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
